newsitem.title: USA: Intensiva HealthCare sees a profit in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Intensiva HealthCare sees a profit in FY97.

text.p: Intensiva HealthCare Corp said Monday it remains on course to reach its goal of profitability during 1997.

The company, which provides acute long-term care for critically ill or injured patients, also reported a loss of $1.6 million, or $0.18 a share, compared to a loss of $873,709, or $0.56 a share, in the same period one year ago.
The latest loss was lower than expected, the company said.
Intensiva added it opened hospitals in three Midwestern cities in the quarter and plans to open 11 more in 1997.
Its shares were off 1/16 Monday at 7-1/4.
